feedback.problem:
The following equation is true for all values of $x.$

$$
4{x}^{2}+bx+1=4{x}^{2}+9x+1
$$

What is the value of the constant $b?$
feedback.worked_solution:
Since the equation is true for all values of $x,$ the expressions on both sides must be exactly the same. That means the coefficients of the matching powers of $x$ must be equal.

We compare the linear terms on both sides. On the left-hand side, the coefficient of $x$ is $b.$ On the right-hand side, the coefficient of $x$ is $9.$

So, we have

$$
b=9.
$$
